title: Stafford’s Conjecture 3.8: paper and Lean proof comparison
description:
Open the paper and Lean proof comparison.

All 57 manuscript passages beside their mapped Lean declarations and complete proof bodies, with direct links to the exact sources. Includes offline HTML, manuscript and proof-details PDFs, and reproducible source pins. Download the ZIP, unzip it, and open index.html in a browser.

Uses formal proof v1.3.1 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23127367). Proposed manuscript corrections remain subject to author review.
